correctness.rationale: Taking the established finite stationary weights as explicit premises, the Bernoulli-minus/geometric-plus product has Z_L=[z^F](1+vz)^C(1-z)^(-B) and marked numerator Cv[z^(F-1)](1+vz)^(C-1)(1-z)^(-B), with v=alpha/(1-alpha). For fixed interior densities and alpha in (0,1), the conditioned local CLT at mean fugacity gives Bernoulli occupation t. Solving f=ct+beta(1-alpha)t/(alpha-t) selects the smaller quadratic root, and Q=rho-ct. The exact discriminant identity yields strict noise enhancement, monotonicity, and the stated sqrt crossover. Independently compared original double sums to coefficient identities in three rational cases, and verified the critical coefficients algebraically. The limit is thermodynamic first, zero-noise second; no uniform size-noise assertion.
